findings.highlight: I’ll go and show Saber around
findings.evidenceJa: こうなったら開き直って
findings.governingReading: at this point he will brazen it out and show Saber the school
findings.explanation: Shirou’s resigned decision to stop being self-conscious disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: そうゆう属性も何も
findings.governingReading: what do you mean, that kind of attribute?
findings.explanation: Shirou’s rejection of Taiga’s personality-category joke becomes a non sequitur excluding himself.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちの思惑とセイバーの思惑はズレている
findings.governingReading: his intention and Saber’s intention are misaligned
findings.explanation: Different purposes for the tour are reduced to differing expectations.

findings.highlight: It might be as big as the front grounds
findings.evidenceJa: 正面グラウンドに匹敵するようなしないような
findings.governingReading: it may—or may not—rival the front athletic ground
findings.explanation: Shirou’s deliberately evasive comic comparison loses its self-cancelling half.

findings.highlight: I start out from a nearby place, the woods behind the archery range
findings.evidenceJa: 弓道場から歩いて数分の裏山に案内する
findings.governingReading: he guides her to the back hill a few minutes on foot from the archery hall
findings.explanation: The tour destination and walking distance become a vague starting point.

findings.evidenceJa: 棘のある感想ありがとう
findings.governingReading: thanks for the barbed observation
findings.explanation: Saber’s pointed wit is generalized as mere harshness.

findings.evidenceJa: 落胆するコトなどない
findings.governingReading: there is therefore nothing for her to be disappointed about
findings.explanation: A dry denial of disappointment becomes an unnatural claim about retaining hope.

findings.evidenceJa: つーん、とそっぽを向くセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber turns away with a pointed, petulant huff
findings.explanation: Saber’s comic sulking gesture disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 完全に不機嫌
findings.governingReading: thoroughly displeased
findings.explanation: Anger or bad temper is changed into disappointment.

findings.evidenceJa: あんまり顔出さないようにしてくれ
findings.governingReading: try not to show yourself much
findings.explanation: A warning about visibility and attracting notice becomes a spatial-distance instruction.

findings.evidenceJa: 野球部が一番
findings.governingReading: the baseball club is the strongest among the athletic clubs
findings.explanation: An institutional club ranking becomes an assertion about the sport itself.

findings.evidenceJa: 主導者の動きに合わせて民衆が動く
findings.governingReading: the populace moves in accordance with its leader
findings.explanation: Saber’s imagined command structure assigns authority to a leader, not a front-line vanguard.

findings.evidenceJa: せわしなく校庭を眺めるセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber busily and restlessly scans the athletic ground
findings.explanation: The urgency and active searching in Saber’s gaze disappear.

findings.highlight: that sport looked fun to me
findings.evidenceJa: 楽しそうに見えたもので、つい
findings.governingReading: because that one sport looked enjoyable, she found herself looking for it
findings.explanation: Saber’s embarrassed admission that the impulse escaped her involuntarily is weakened.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣でする球遊び
findings.governingReading: a ball game played with swords
findings.explanation: The defining object and action of Saber’s childhood-like anecdote disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: おかしくて頬がにやけてしまう
findings.governingReading: the image amuses him until his cheeks loosen into a grin
findings.explanation: Shirou’s involuntary visible delight disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber pushes me to keep going with the tour
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーに押されて校内に移動する
findings.governingReading: Saber physically ushers or pushes him into the school building
findings.explanation: Physical staging becomes an abstract motivational push.

findings.highlight: Only Rin’s magical energy fills the hallways
findings.evidenceJa: 廊下や校舎に残ったものは凛の魔力だけ
findings.governingReading: the only magical energy remaining in the hallways and building is Rin’s residue
findings.explanation: A lingering trace is made into energy actively filling the space.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーから緊張感が薄れていく
findings.governingReading: Saber’s tension gradually begins to thin
findings.explanation: A gradual reduction is made complete.

findings.evidenceJa: このわずかな間で
findings.governingReading: within this brief span, he has come to understand
findings.explanation: The speed with which trust developed disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 言葉以上に理解できていた
findings.governingReading: he understood it more powerfully than words could express
findings.explanation: The nonverbal strength of Saber’s demonstrated concern disappears.

findings.highlight: We’re here, so we might as well, right?
findings.evidenceJa: せっかくだから中を案内しようと思ってさ
findings.governingReading: since they came this far, Shirou thought he would show Saber inside
findings.explanation: A clear statement of Shirou’s intent becomes an incomplete rhetorical suggestion.

findings.evidenceJa: 倍近く違うとは、曖昧にも程がある
findings.governingReading: a range differing by nearly twofold is ambiguity beyond reason
findings.explanation: Saber’s precise mathematical basis for criticizing Shirou’s estimate disappears.

findings.highlight: They’re using how fast they can run 50 meters as points
findings.evidenceJa: 五十メートルを何秒で走れるかって[ruby text=タイム char=2]得点を競ってる
findings.governingReading: they compete over their times—how many seconds it takes to run fifty meters
findings.explanation: Measured race time is incorrectly described as points.

findings.highlight: playing a similar sport with a sword
findings.evidenceJa: 剣で似たような球遊びをして
findings.governingReading: playing a similar ball game with swords
findings.explanation: Saber’s concrete, curious sword-and-ball game is generalized before being omitted again in Shirou’s response.
